# Opinion - Create & Share Polls
> Create polls, collect anonymous or verified feedback, and analyze responses in real-time.

## About
Opinion is a free online polling platform that lets you create polls, share them with a single link, and collect responses - anonymously or with authentication. It includes live analytics dashboards, anti-spam protection via Cloudflare Turnstile, and real-time collaboration.

## Key Features
- Anonymous or authenticated polling modes
- Live analytics with per-question breakdowns
- Real-time collaboration via Socket.io
- Anti-spam protection (Cloudflare Turnstile + fingerprinting)
- Shareable poll links
- Auto-expiry for polls with countdown timer
- Duplicate vote prevention
